The time-domain waveform shows normalized digital amplitudes of both channels. X-Y display plots the left channel horizontally and the right channel vertically. The spectrum uses dBFS and marks the strongest spectral peaks. Its history shows the newest samples at the top. Pinch horizontally to zoom the frequency axis; drag horizontally to pan. Analysis uses source audio before playback speed, pitch, and volume processing. It does not measure sound pressure level.
Digital amplitude · L: blue / R: orange

Frequency peaks are estimated by a discrete Fourier transform of the source audio. Frequency resolution depends on the sample rate and analysis window. dBFS is relative to digital full scale and cannot measure environmental noise or hearing risk.
